{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-5yio","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: Responder TH_4 computed from plaintext+credential instead of ciphertext","description":"In rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:1341, the EdhocResponder::finish_process_message_3 method calls transcript_4 with 3 arguments (th_3, pending.plaintext, peer.credential) but:
- transcript_4 at line 432 takes only 2 params (th_3, ciphertext_3)
- The initiator at line 913 correctly uses ciphertext_3.0
- The Python implementation (both initiator and responder) consistently uses cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_3)
- This mismatch means initiator and responder would compute different TH_4 values, breaking key derivation and OSCORE context agreement.
- The responder should pass the decrypted message_3 ciphertext (e.g., ciphertext_3.0) to transcript_4, matching both the initiator and the Python reference implementation.","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T19:36:01.820308547Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T19:36:01.820308547Z"}
